notes_for_editor: Dates and agency rest on one listing (firelookout.com). The West Valley Naturalists article lists a Hubbart Lookout among the Northern Montana Fire Association's three lookouts but gives no date, so it is not known to be the same structure as the 1956 cabin. The Forest Lookouts (montanalookouts.weebly.com) page gives legal location 25N-24W-9 and spells the agency 'Montana DRNC'; it was read but not cited. No source describes present condition or access. No photos with a clear licence were found.
